title: Labor Supply and Firm Size
title_zh: 劳动力供给与企业规模
title_primary: 劳动力供给与企业规模
title_secondary: Labor Supply and Firm Size
authors: Lin Shao, Faisal Sohail, Emircan Yurdagul
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Larger firms feature (i) longer hours worked, (ii) higher wages, and (iii) smaller (larger) wage penalties for working long (short) hours. We reconcile these patterns in a general equilibrium model, which features the endogenous interaction of hours, wages, and firm size. In the model, workers willing to work longer hours sort into larger firms that offer a wage premium. Complementarities in hours generate wage penalties that increase with the distance from the usual hours. We use the model to argue that variation in average hours across firms contributes significantly to wage inequality.
abstract_zh: 大企业具有以下特征：（i）工作时间更长，（ii）工资更高，（iii）对长时间（短时间）工作的工资惩罚更小（更大）。我们在一个一般均衡模型中调和了这些模式，该模型包含了工作时间、工资与企业规模的内生互动。在模型中，愿意工作更长时间的工人会进入提供工资溢价的大企业。工作时间上的互补性产生了工资惩罚，这些惩罚随着与常规工作时间的距离增加而增大。我们利用该模型论证，企业间平均工作时间的差异对工资不平等有显著贡献。

title: Financial Interdependence and Currency Internationalization
title_zh: 金融相互依存与货币国际化
title_primary: 金融相互依存与货币国际化
title_secondary: Financial Interdependence and Currency Internationalization
authors: Zhengyang Jiang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Does financial opening necessarily lead to currency internationalization? To study the competition between incumbent and rising powers under financial interdependence, we develop a model of asset demand with microfounded network effects. Search frictions with currency-specialized intermediaries generate distinct notions of liquidity at asset-market and currency-area levels, which jointly shape the trajectory of currency competition. In the U.S.-China context, China at early stages of financial development benefits from pooling its assets with the dollar area, which reinforces the status quo. As China's financial markets deepen, RMB issuance allows China to internalize network effects and erode the dollar's dominance, triggering a discrete shift toward fragmentation. This transition is further shaped by sanctions, financial repression, and third-country responses, highlighting how financial interdependence transforms cooperation into rivalry in the evolution of the international financial order.
abstract_zh: 金融开放是否必然导致货币国际化？为研究金融相互依存下在位大国与新兴大国之间的竞争，我们构建了一个具有微观基础网络效应的资产需求模型。带有货币专业化中介的搜索摩擦在资产市场与货币区域两个层面产生了不同的流动性概念，二者共同塑造了货币竞争的轨迹。在中美背景下，中国在金融发展初期通过将其资产与美元区域合并而获益，这强化了现状。随着中国金融市场深化，人民币发行使中国能够内化网络效应并削弱美元的主导地位，从而引发向碎片化的离散转变。这一转变进一步受到制裁、金融抑制及第三国反应的影响，凸显了金融相互依存如何在国际金融秩序演变中将合作转化为竞争。

title: Progressive and Robust Scoring Rules: Axiomatic Taxonomy
title_zh: 渐进且稳健的评分规则：公理分类
title_primary: 渐进且稳健的评分规则：公理分类
title_secondary: Progressive and Robust Scoring Rules: Axiomatic Taxonomy
authors: Guy Barokas, S. Nitzan
abstract: Progressive social ranking rules assign greater weight to shifts in voters' preferences occurring lower in their ranking, potentially enhancing egalitarianism between individuals with more and with less favored alternatives, compared to non-progressive rules. Weakly robust ranking rules are not overly sensitive to the smallest admissible change in an individual’s preferences. We axiomatically characterize four classes of progressive and weakly robust ranking rules: the comprehensive class, the negative quadratic (NQ) class, the constant absolute inequality aversion (CAIA) class and, in a continuous setting, the constant relative inequality aversion (CRIA) class. We also identify the subclass satisfying a stronger robustness requirement that limits excessive sensitivity to bottom-rank changes. The rules within the CAIA class are parameterized by a variable β ∈ ( 1 , ∞ ) , representing progressivity levels. The Borda and inverse plurality rules are obtained as special cases at the lower and upper bounds of β . Selecting the appropriate rule within this class requires deciding upon the desired level of progressivity and we illustrate how one can opt for a context-dependent choice of β by employing the median voter theorem. Finally, we provide a complete taxonomy of our four classes and the Borda rule, which leads to the axiomatization of the negative squared Borda rule, demonstrating its unique position within the intersection of the NQ and CRIA classes.
abstract_zh: 渐进式社会排序规则赋予选民偏好中排名较低位置的变化以更大的权重，与非渐进式规则相比，这可能在拥有更受青睐和较少受青睐备选方案的个体之间增强平等主义。弱稳健排序规则对个体偏好中最小的可允许变化不过度敏感。我们公理化地刻画了四类渐进且弱稳健的排序规则：综合类、负二次（NQ）类、常数绝对不平等厌恶（CAIA）类，以及在连续设定下的常数相对不平等厌恶（CRIA）类。我们还识别出一个满足更强稳健性要求的子类，该要求限制了对底部排名变化的过度敏感性。CAIA类中的规则由参数β∈(1,∞)参数化，代表渐进性水平。博尔达规则和逆多数规则分别在β的下界和上界处作为特例获得。在此类中选择合适的规则需要决定所需的渐进性水平，我们通过运用中位选民定理说明如何根据情境选择β。最后，我们提供了我们四类规则与博尔达规则的完整分类体系，这引出了负平方博尔达规则的公理化，展示了其在NQ和CRIA类交集内的独特地位。

title: Generative AI-assisted investor communication and stock price crash risk
title_zh: 生成式AI辅助投资者沟通与股价崩盘风险
title_primary: 生成式AI辅助投资者沟通与股价崩盘风险
title_secondary: Generative AI-assisted investor communication and stock price crash risk
authors: Ruinan Cao, Zongxin Zhang
abstract: This study examines the effect of managerial responses assisted by generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) on stock price crash risk. Using question–response data from investor-relations platforms operated by Chinese stock exchanges, we employ large language models (LLMs) to measure the degree of GenAI assistance in managerial responses. We find that stronger GenAI-assisted textual features predict higher future stock price crash risk. We further show that greater response–question mismatch and more negative investor sentiment serve as two potential mechanisms, and that the effect is more pronounced among firms with more frequent investor interactions.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了生成式人工智能（GenAI）辅助的管理层回复对股价崩盘风险的影响。基于中国证券交易所投资者关系平台的问答数据，我们运用大语言模型（LLMs）测度管理层回复中GenAI辅助程度。研究发现，GenAI辅助文本特征越显著，未来股价崩盘风险越高。进一步分析表明，回复与问题匹配度降低及投资者负面情绪加剧是两条潜在作用机制，且该效应在投资者互动更频繁的企业中更为显著。

title: Cultural origins of preventive health care utilization
title_zh: 预防性医疗保健利用的文化起源
title_primary: 预防性医疗保健利用的文化起源
title_secondary: Cultural origins of preventive health care utilization
authors: Jan Bietenbeck, Lukas Maschmann, Therese Nilsson, Devon Spika
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine whether preventive health care uptake varies with cultural background related to patience and risk-taking. We combine individual-level survey data on preventive care use from 27 European countries with country-level preference measures from the Global Preferences Survey. To reduce confounding from institutional and economic correlates of culture, we focus on second-generation immigrants, who were born and currently reside in the same country – and thus face the same health care system and broad economic environment – but differ in inherited cultural background through their parents’ countries of origin. We find that respondents from more patient cultural backgrounds are more likely to use preventive services, while those from more risk-tolerant backgrounds are less likely to do so. These patterns appear across multiple preventive care outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文考察预防性医疗服务的利用是否因与耐心和风险偏好相关的文化背景而异。我们将来自27个欧洲国家的个体层面预防性护理使用调查数据，与全球偏好调查中的国家层面偏好指标相结合。为减少文化与制度、经济因素之间的混杂效应，我们聚焦于第二代移民——他们出生并居住在同一国家，因此面临相同的医疗体系与宏观经济环境，但通过父母的原籍国继承了不同的文化背景。研究发现，来自更具耐心文化背景的受访者更倾向于使用预防性服务，而来自更具风险容忍背景的受访者则较少使用。这一模式在多种预防性护理结果中均得到体现。

title: Neighborhood Effects and Missing Markets for Opportunity
title_zh: 邻里效应与机会市场的缺失
title_primary: 邻里效应与机会市场的缺失
title_secondary: Neighborhood Effects and Missing Markets for Opportunity
authors: Lawrence F. Katz
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Experimental and quasi-experimental studies show that childhood neighborhoods have substantial causal impacts on children’s adult earnings and other long-term socioeconomic outcomes. Several market failures are likely to lead to excessive residential segregation by parental income and to an under-supply of mixed-income neighborhoods. Missing markets for opportunity originate in capital market imperfections for borrowing on children’s future earnings, neighbor spillovers, behavioral biases, and housing search frictions. Customized housing mobility services combined with subsidized housing vouchers can help low-income families move to higher-opportunity areas. Place-based policies that create mixed-income neighborhoods appear to increase long-term outcomes for less-advantaged children.
abstract_zh: 实验与准实验研究表明，童年居住社区对儿童成年后的收入及其他长期社会经济结果具有显著的因果影响。多种市场失灵可能导致按父母收入划分的居住隔离过度，并造成混合收入社区供给不足。机会缺失的市场源于儿童未来收入借贷的资本市场不完善、邻里溢出效应、行为偏差以及住房搜寻摩擦。定制化住房流动服务与补贴性住房券相结合，可帮助低收入家庭迁往机会更多的区域。创建混合收入社区的属地化政策似乎能改善弱势儿童的长期发展结果。

title: Social learning in agriculture: A scalable farmer-to-farmer extension approach for dairy farmers
title_zh: 农业中的社会学习：一种可扩展的奶农间推广方法
title_primary: 农业中的社会学习：一种可扩展的奶农间推广方法
title_secondary: Social learning in agriculture: A scalable farmer-to-farmer extension approach for dairy farmers
authors: Luc Behaghel, Jérémie Gignoux, Karen Macours
abstract: We evaluate a farmer training intervention for smallholder dairy farmers in Uganda, demonstrating that an at-scale version of the “contact farmer” extension model can significantly increase milk production and be cost-effective. In this model, one “farmer trainer” is selected per village and trained to disseminate knowledge to other farmers. Using experimental sub-treatment arms, and a combination of observed and self-reported data, we assess three key components designed to enhance the program’s impact: (i) non-monetary incentives for farmer trainers, (ii) support from professional extension agents, and (iii) a curriculum that combines key principles of animal nutrition and technology choice with a broad set of feeding practices. Results show positive impacts along the hypothesized causal chain, from knowledge acquisition by farmer trainers to knowledge of the farmers they train, and increases in their technology adoption, production, and profits.

title: Trade policy uncertainty, organization of firms, and the form of international trade
title_zh: 贸易政策不确定性、企业组织与国际贸易形式
title_primary: 贸易政策不确定性、企业组织与国际贸易形式
title_secondary: Trade policy uncertainty, organization of firms, and the form of international trade
authors: Felix Fosu
abstract: This paper investigates the hypothesis that lower trade policy uncertainty (TPU) reduces the share of intrafirm trade in total trade. A significant change in US‐China TPU occurred in 2001 when China joined the WTO, providing a natural experiment to test this hypothesis. Using a difference‐in‐differences approach with industry‐level US data, I examine the trade effects of this change. The results indicate that the reduction in TPU between the US and China led to a significant increase in both US arm's‐length and intrafirm imports from China compared to pre‐WTO levels. Notably, the effect of TPU on arm's‐length trade is approximately twice that on intrafirm trade, with the disparity largely attributed to sunk costs. A simple model of production location and ownership choice under policy uncertainty provides a conceptual framework for understanding these findings.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了贸易政策不确定性（TPU）降低会减少公司内贸易在总贸易中占比这一假说。2001年中国加入WTO使美中贸易政策不确定性发生显著变化，为检验该假说提供了自然实验。本文采用双重差分法，基于美国行业层面数据，考察了这一变化带来的贸易效应。结果表明，相较于入世前水平，美中贸易政策不确定性的降低显著增加了美国从中国的独立企业间贸易和公司内进口。值得注意的是，贸易政策不确定性对独立企业间贸易的影响约为公司内贸易的两倍，这一差异主要归因于沉没成本。一个关于政策不确定性下生产区位与所有权选择的简单模型，为理解上述发现提供了概念框架。

title: Trading Institutions, Emotional Arousal, and Overbidding
title_zh: 交易制度、情绪唤醒与过度出价
title_primary: 交易制度、情绪唤醒与过度出价
title_secondary: Trading Institutions, Emotional Arousal, and Overbidding
authors: Nobuyuki Hanaki, Brice Corgnet, Camille Cornand
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
abstract: We investigate the influence of trading institutions on emotional arousal and bidding behavior through a series of behavioral and physiological experiments involving an investment task. In line with the competitive arousal hypothesis, we show that market institutions exacerbate the emotional arousal associated with winning bids, especially when buying an asset leads to substantial earnings. The market treatment exhibits stronger overbidding and bubble dynamics than baselines that use a Becker-DeGroot-Marschak mechanism. Treatment differences disappear for investors who exhibit no base rate emotional arousal. Our study shows that emotions are an important mechanism for understanding market outcomes and suggests designing new trading institutions to mitigate competitive arousal and subsequent overbidding in markets.

title: Learning at Scale: Infrastructure, Aid Effectiveness, and World Bank Performance
title_zh: 大规模学习：基础设施、援助有效性与世界银行绩效
title_primary: 大规模学习：基础设施、援助有效性与世界银行绩效
title_secondary: Learning at Scale: Infrastructure, Aid Effectiveness, and World Bank Performance
authors: Lall, Somik, Su, Xinyi, Vagliasindi, Maria
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract_zh: 本文利用世界银行60年间2500个基础设施项目的事后经济回报率，重新审视援助有效性。研究发现三个事实：第一，平均价值创造水平较高——经济回报率均值为24%（中位数为18.5%）；第二，回报率随时间递增——在20世纪80年代中期前保持相对稳定后，自80年代末起经济回报率持续上升，这与项目筛选、设计及交付质量的改善相吻合；第三，制度薄弱国家的经济回报率系统性更高。在此类国家中，世界银行的高质量绩效可使平均经济回报率提升约12个百分点。其潜在机制在于人才配置：更优质的项目团队负责人被不成比例地分配到最具挑战性的环境中，尽管面临更长周期、更高强度的实施过程，却能显著缩短项目见效时间并提升经济回报率。总体而言，除国家基本面因素外，世界银行的绩效表现与人才配置能实质性提升稀缺资本的回报率——尤其在治理薄弱地区效果更为显著。

title: When Lasry-Lions meet Krugman: A mean-field game theory of spatial dynamics
title_zh: 当Lasry-Lions遇见Krugman：空间动力学的平均场博弈理论
title_primary: 当Lasry-Lions遇见Krugman：空间动力学的平均场博弈理论
title_secondary: When Lasry-Lions meet Krugman: A mean-field game theory of spatial dynamics
authors: M. Bahlali, R. Boucekkine, Q. Petit
abstract: We propose a mean-field game (MFG) approach to study the dynamics of spatial agglomeration in a continuous space-time framework where trade across locations may follow a broad class of static gravity models. Forward-looking intertemporal utility-maximizing agents work and migrate in a two-dimensional geography and face idiosyncratic shocks. Equilibrium wages and prices depend on their common distribution and adjust statically according to the underlying trade model. We first prove existence and uniqueness of the static trade equilibrium. We then prove existence of dynamic equilibria. In the case of a circular economy, we obtain closed-form solutions for small perturbations around the steady state, and we identify the sets of parameters that lead to agglomeration or dispersion. We exploit the MFG structure of the model to explicitly quantify how uncertainty and forward-looking expectations contribute to agglomeration and dispersion. In particular, we show that, regardless of the static trade model, forward-looking expectations always promote agglomeration, but cannot reverse the dominant pattern that would arise under myopic behavior.

title: No man’s land? The effect of forced displacement on forest cover change in Colombia
title_zh: 无人之地？强迫迁移对哥伦比亚森林覆盖变化的影响
title_primary: 无人之地？强迫迁移对哥伦比亚森林覆盖变化的影响
title_secondary: No man’s land? The effect of forced displacement on forest cover change in Colombia
authors: Emilio Leguízamo, Ana María Montoya
official: 官方在线 November 2 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Globally, state-based armed conflict has increased by more than 50 percent over the past decade. The environmental consequences of such conflict are often overlooked. To help fill that gap, we examine the effect on forest cover of conflict-related forced displacement in Colombia. We use fine-scale annual data on forest cover change derived from satellite images along with data culled from court records of displacement events, using computational text analysis, to estimate staggered difference-in-differences models. We find that displacement leads to a 50 percent increase in deforestation. This effect is likely due to the expansion of both legal and illegal economic activities following displacement. It is most pronounced when paramilitary groups are the sole actors involved in displacement and where economic returns to cleared land uses are high. In principle, these results could be used to target efforts to reduce environmental damage associated with civil conflict.

title: Firm-level production networks: What do we (really) know?
title_zh: 企业层面的生产网络：我们（真正）了解什么？
title_primary: 企业层面的生产网络：我们（真正）了解什么？
title_secondary: Firm-level production networks: What do we (really) know?
authors: Andrea Bacilieri, András Borsos, Pablo Astudillo-Estévez, Mads Hoefer, François Lafond
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Are standard production network properties similar across all available datasets, and if not, why? We provide benchmark results from two administrative datasets (Ecuador and Hungary), which are exceptional in that they have no reporting threshold. We compare these networks with a leading commercial dataset (FactSet) and published results on national firm-level production networks. Administrative datasets with no reporting thresholds have remarkably similar quantitative properties, while a number of important properties are biased in datasets with missing data.
abstract_zh: 标准生产网络属性在所有可用数据集中是否相似？若否，原因何在？我们提供了来自两个行政数据集（厄瓜多尔和匈牙利）的基准结果，这些数据集因其无报告门槛而尤为特殊。我们将这些网络与领先的商业数据集（FactSet）及已发表的关于国家企业级生产网络的结果进行比较。无报告门槛的行政数据集在定量属性上表现出显著相似性，而含缺失数据的数据集中若干重要属性则存在偏差。

title: Imported intermediate digital inputs and income inequality
title_zh: 进口中间数字投入与收入不平等
title_primary: 进口中间数字投入与收入不平等
title_secondary: Imported intermediate digital inputs and income inequality
authors: Yanne Gabriella Velomasy, Yueling Wei, Hongsheng Zhang, Laixun Zhao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-01-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper analyzes the impacts of importing intermediate digital inputs (IDIs) on income inequality between high-skilled and low-skilled workers, using a novel dataset that merges recent EU KLEMS and OECD data for 29 countries and 15 industries for 2008-2020. We find that IDI imports significantly widen income inequality, because such imports are associated with higher technology and capital intensities, which directly increase income inequality by complementing high-skilled labor while substituting for low-skilled labor, and indirectly exacerbate inequality through workforce skill upgrading. Heterogeneity analysis shows that these occur primarily in highly digitalized countries and industries, as well as technology-intensive sectors. We also construct two shift-share instrumental variables, namely the global imported IDI shocks and the global digital export shocks, to address endogeneity.

title: A New Keynesian Phillips curve estimation for a small open economy in the presence of structural changes: empirical evidence from Turkey
title_zh: 结构变化下小型开放经济体的新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线估计：来自土耳其的经验证据
title_primary: 结构变化下小型开放经济体的新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线估计：来自土耳其的经验证据
title_secondary: A New Keynesian Phillips curve estimation for a small open economy in the presence of structural changes: empirical evidence from Turkey
authors: Salih Yildirim Kadir Y. Eryigit a Department of Economics, Bursa Uludağ University, Bursa, Turkeyb Department of Econometrics, Turkey
abstract: This study aims to model inflation dynamics by presenting the evidence supporting instability of the Phillips curve for the period covering the explicit inflation targeting (IT) adoption in Turkey as a small open economy. To this end, Bai and Perron approach is applied to capture possible breaks or instability associated with the structural changes in the hybrid New Keynesian Phillips curve (NKPC) estimation, using quarterly data from 2006:q1 to 2023:q4. The empirical findings reveal that the hybrid model of the NKPC with the control variables gives unstable parameter estimations with significant structural breaks which can be related to some structural changes the Turkish economy experienced for post IT periods. The results also put forward that the inflation-output gap relationship produces larger amount of parameter in high inflation period implying that the Phillips curve steepens with changing price setting behaviour and the effects of reel exchange rate and oil prices on domestic inflation rate. Based on these findings, the weaker anchored expectations may increase the output cost because of the changing trade-off between inflation and output gap. The Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey (CBRT) should take its unstable structure into account in the inflation targeting process.

title: Better city, better life: smart city policy and corporate ESG performance
title_zh: 智慧城市，美好生活：智慧城市政策与企业ESG表现
title_primary: 智慧城市，美好生活：智慧城市政策与企业ESG表现
title_secondary: Better city, better life: smart city policy and corporate ESG performance
authors: Yao Zhou, Meng Meng, Jingjing Gao
abstract: Using data from Chinese listed companies, this study examines the overall impact of the smart city policy (SCP) on corporate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance, focusing on the distinct effects across the E, S, and G dimensions. Using a multiperiod difference-in-differences (DID) approach, we analyse 24647 firm-year observations from 2009 to 2021, leveraging the three-stage SCP rollout as a quasi-natural experiment. The results indicate that the SCP improves corporate ESG scores by approximately 0.04, with significant enhancements in governance performance. Mechanism analysis also reveals that the SCP fosters ESG improvements through increased R&D investments and market attention, while executive environmental awareness has limited effects. Policy impacts also vary by ownership and industry, with state-owned enterprises, industrial firms, and companies in low-pollution and high-technology sectors obtaining the greatest benefits. Robustness checks, including alternative models and PSM-DID estimations, confirm these findings. Moreover, interaction analysis indicates that the SCP and other sustainability-focused policies (e.g. green credit and resource city policies) act as substitutes rather than complements due to policy priority and resource constraints for companies. Our findings underscore the importance of a coordinated policy design to maximize the collective effectiveness of policies in promoting sustainable corporate practices.
abstract_zh: 基于中国上市公司数据，本研究考察了智慧城市政策（SCP）对企业环境、社会和治理（ESG）绩效的整体影响，重点关注其在E、S、G三个维度上的差异化效应。采用多期双重差分（DID）方法，我们分析了2009年至2021年间24647个公司-年度观测值，将三阶段SCP推广作为准自然实验。结果表明，SCP使企业ESG得分提升约0.04，其中治理绩效的改善尤为显著。机制分析进一步揭示，SCP通过增加研发投入和市场关注度促进ESG改善，而高管环境意识的影响有限。政策效应因所有权性质和行业类型而异，国有企业、工业企业以及低污染和高科技行业的企业获益最大。包括替代模型和倾向得分匹配双重差分（PSM-DID）估计在内的稳健性检验证实了上述发现。此外，交互效应分析表明，由于政策优先级和企业资源约束，SCP与其他可持续发展导向政策（如绿色信贷政策和资源型城市政策）呈现替代而非互补关系。本研究结果强调了协调政策设计对于最大化政策组合在促进企业可持续实践方面整体效能的重要性。
